However, several statements are not supported by the card, and the 'every tier' claim is only partly right, so an investigator would have to redo some checking.","problems":["The claim that 'about a third of notes repeat the same recorded time' has no support on the card or in the tool outputs. The ratios run from about 2.4x to 3.7x, and the 0-condition stratum is 6.6% vs 1.8% (3.7x). Calling the rate 'well above expectation in every tier' is loose.","The comparison figure 'against 9% for comparison providers' is a different quantity from the card's 8.7%, which is the all-provider rate by billed level, so the wording is slightly inconsistent.","The citations C0306897 (J06.9 only) and C0306892 (M54.50 only) as 'simple-sounding visits' are fair, but the summary does not explain why a 99215 on those diagnoses is notable beyond saying they are simple.","The final cited examples are only two claims, both low-complexity, and the 'Examples' text is formulaic.
